name: Jamal Brooks
signout: Fifteen-year-old with chest pain. His mother is very anxious and is asking for a scan. The pain sounds musculoskeletal, but they may need reassurance.
correctDiagnosis: Likely musculoskeletal chest pain without current high-risk features
diagnosisChoices: Likely musculoskeletal chest pain without current high-risk features

pain.parent: He says it is sharp and worse when he twists.
pain.nurse: Pain is reproducible with movement and palpation.

exertion.parent: It did not start with exercise, and he has not fainted.
exertion.nurse: No exertional syncope or collapse is reported.

clot.parent: No long travel, leg swelling, surgery, or clot history.

family.parent: No sudden unexplained death or inherited heart disease in close relatives.

findings.default: Comfortable adolescent speaking in full sentences without distress.

findings.deteriorating: Pain remains reproducible without new features.
findings.postTreatment: Tenderness is reduced after simple analgesia.
